import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Aggregate total sales by product and customer age group
sales_agg = df.groupby(['product', 'customer_age_group'])['total'].sum().unstack()

# Create a heatmap to visualize sales distribution
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.heatmap(sales_agg, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='YlGnBu', linewidths=0.5)
plt.title('Total Sales by Product and Customer Age Group')
plt.xlabel('Customer Age Group')
plt.ylabel('Product')
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Aggregate total sales by product and customer age group
sales_agg = df.groupby(['product', 'customer_age_group'])['total'].sum().unstack()

# Create a heatmap to visualize sales distribution
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.heatmap(sales_agg, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='YlGnBu', linewidths=0.5)
plt.title('Total Sales by Product and Customer Age Group')
plt.xlabel('Customer Age Group')
plt.ylabel('Product')
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
